map_ambience._doc: BTA (map_ambience.cpp, docs/map-ambience.md): trims (0-2) on the per-map ambience by category, over the levels in content/audio/maps/<map>.json; all on the Ambience volume

steps._doc: BTA: level (x) of the winter footstep surfaces (custom/bta/steps_*.mp3, each step cut to the same peak); the older surfaces stay at 1

note: music (SND21): x on the main-menu track (0-2; master applies). heartbeat / hurt (SND13): x on the low-health heartbeat loop and the hurt grunt (0-4). Levels of user-supplied sounds and the gun reverb, read at load (Audio::loadCustom). casing_gain: x on the spent-case landing (1 = the SND4 level; 2 = twice it, about +6 dB), 0-3. reverb: per class, send (0-1: how much of the shot feeds the reverb) and tail_s (the tail's decay time outdoors; tunnels / Backrooms make it 1.4x longer): gun = every gun not listed below, mg = M249, MG 42, M2HB (carried and emplaced), fifty = the .50 sniper. guns (SND7): per gun id, a gain (x on its shot, 0-2; the limiter keeps it from clipping) or {gain, body}: body is the low-mid weight and saturation drive baked in at load (0 none, about 2-4; M249 / MG 42 2.2, M2HB 3, .50 4). tank_gun / shell_hit (SND9): the tank main gun and a tank / AT / field-gun shell bursting: gain (0-2), body (saturation drive), full_level_m (full level within this range), rolloff (lower carries further); reverb.tank is their reverb (send, tail_s). minigun / cannon30 (SND9, the Abrams roof minigun and the Apache's 30 mm): also min_gap_ms (rounds closer than this at one spot are carried by the previous body: a continuous roar), max_voices (overlapping bodies) and rolloff. reload (WP6): reload / magazine / clip / bolt / pump foley level, gain_db over the Effects level (7 = about 2.2x), trim_db per weapon id (dB, added); it is never on the gunfire bus or the gun reverb.

botSteps._doc: SND10: bot footsteps (game.cpp botFootstep): heard within these ranges by gait, these volumes (effects bus), through a wall at throughWallVolume within 60 % of the range; at most maxPerSecond steps start
